name: High School Conservation Crews (Southwest Conservation Corps)
city: Four Corners and Los Valles regions, CO
what_you_do: Join a paid outdoor crew in your region for 4 to 5 weeks. Do conservation work, get food in the field, safety gear and lessons from trained staff.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 14 to 18. You live in the Four Corners region. That is Archuleta, Dolores, La Plata, Montezuma and San Juan counties and northern New Mexico counties. Or you live in the Los Valles region. That is Park, Chaffee, Saguache, Mineral and Rio Grande, Alamosa, Costilla and Conejos counties.
pay_detail: $14.42 per hour, 32 to 40 hours per week
duration: Two sessions: late May to June, or mid July to mid August. Each is 4 to 5 weeks.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link for Summer 2026 but shows no closing date. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link for your region on the page. Find your region on the county map.
notes: The Colorado Youth Corps Association page lists other youth corps by county. They are Boulder County, Larimer County, Mile High Youth Corps and Rocky Mountain Youth Corps. The last has a youth program for ages 14 to 18 in Steamboat Springs. They also list Weld County and Western Colorado. Ask each one for the ages and dates.
